extracted.name: Jimmy Carter Dessert
extracted.description: This Jimmy Carter dessert is made with a graham cracker crust filled with peanut butter, cream cheese, and a layer of vanilla and chocolate pudding.
ingredient_lines: 2 (8 ounce) containers frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (3.4 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate pudding mix
instruction_lines: Combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter or margarine. Press firmly into the bottom of a 13x9-inch pan.
Mix cream cheese and peanut butter together until smooth. Stir in 2 cups of whipped topping and confectioners' sugar. Pour mixture over crust.
Mix pudding mixes and milk together and pour over peanut butter layer. Spread remaining whipped topping on top. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and shaved chocolate. Chill for at least 4 hours.
